fusions.name: Roost Drop
fusions.desc: Drops you onto a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaving it [Pinned] under a mesh for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Echo off the Walls
fusions.desc: Sends a high pulse through a mesh that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 40% chance per hit to leave them [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Canopy of Dusk
fusions.desc: Draws a mesh of darkness over you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 10% faster. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Flit and Fling
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a strand builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a weighted mesh strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per strand (109% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 10 seconds.
